status: DRAFT_REGISTERED_BEFORE_ANY_TEMPORAL_CACHE_EXTRACTION; criteria below are the screen criteria; confirmatory criteria are frozen separately before any external result
question: Does keeping temporal evidence in a materialized OlmoEarth cache (instead of the time-and-group mean that the sealed cache and the GEO-Bench-2 protocol both use) make the cache more useful for a frozen-cache decoder, at a bounded extra byte budget?
why_now: The sealed extractor pools OlmoEarth tokens over (time, band-group) [extract_sen12_fold_cache.py:embed_crop]; GEO-Bench-2 likewise encodes each timestamp separately and averages embeddings before the decoder (arXiv 2511.15658 v2). Both discard within-window temporal structure that OlmoEarth already computed.
development_data: Sen12Landslides, folds holdout_chimanimani (val china) and holdout_hiroshima (val hokkaido) — both previously exposed; Korea, DEN, other GEO-Bench-2 tasks are NOT touched by this screen

cache.contract: identical to sealed (4x64 crops, patch 4, token_pooling, B01/B09 zero + band-set 2 MISSING, synthetic month timestamps)
cache.audit: mean over T must reproduce the sealed emb_fp16 within fp16 tolerance on >=50 tiles; otherwise the screen is void

arms.diffpca: mean + PCA-32 of late-half minus early-half mean, PCA fit on source train tiles only; +32 ch, +64 KiB/tile
arms.sketch: mean + learned 1x1 conv over source-fit PCA-64 per-timestep stack -> 32 ch; +32 ch, +64 KiB/tile (byte-matched to diffpca)
arms.full: learned 1x1 conv over the PCA-64 per-timestep stack -> 128 ch, no mean; bounded reference readout, not an upper bound

runs: 4 readouts x 2 folds x seeds {1,2,3} = 24 decoder runs, code/temporal_readout_train.py, identical decoder recipe to cache_decoder_train.py

metrics.primary: exact pixel AP on the test region
metrics.report: seed mean and per-seed values; paired differences vs mean arm

screen_rule.temporal_information_useful: diffpca OR sketch beats mean on primary AP in BOTH folds (seed mean), with absolute gain >= .02 in at least one fold and no fold worse by more than .01
screen_rule.learned_sketch_novelty: ONLY if sketch beats diffpca by >= .02 AP in both folds; if sketch ~ diffpca, report 'temporal information is useful' and do NOT claim a learned method
screen_rule.fail: neither diffpca nor sketch passes -> temporal-evidence candidate closed on Sen12; the T1 causal-update pilot is not started
screen_rule.full_arm_role: context only; if full << mean, the PCA-64 bound is too tight and the full arm is re-run with pca_dim 128 before interpretation

not_claimed: change-timing or early-detection performance (Sen12 has one terminal mask)
compute savings (cache is computed from the full window)
next_if_pass: freeze confirmatory criteria; run the same 4 arms on GEO-Bench-2 temporal tasks whose raw data ships per-timestep tensors (PASTIS-R, BioMassters, KuroSiwo, Fields of the World, DynamicEarthNet) against the benchmark's own timestamp-averaging protocol
gpu_order: after resolution_contract_v2 completes; extraction ~1 h (123 GB), 24 runs ~4 h
